sourceFile: 01. MSU-L20S15-07 Report test New Dry UV Machine 395nm ( Normal 365nm) date 2.05.2025 - Copy_1778470633_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is based on a valid comparable 395nm vs 365nm dry UV test but the changed factor and LED outcome grouping are not reliable.
issues: Changed factor is a filename instead of 395nm new dry UV versus normal 365nm.
Baseline and changed conditions are marked not explicit despite clear source rows.
LED UV outcomes use header/aggregate rows and produce invalid stats/spec violations.
Two sheets have different titles/specs and need product or sheet subgroup handling.
Some cited rows are not present in the supplied contextRows.
requiredUserQuestions: Should sheets 161016 and 201507 be separate cases or subgroups under one validation?
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to new dry UV 395nm vs normal dry UV 365nm.
Set baseline as 365nm normal and changed condition as 395nm test using process rows.
Use sheet/product, date, test round, film use, and spec as subgroup keys.
Rebuild LED UV outcomes from actual test/normal data rows, not header rows.
Keep tension outcomes with correct spec, averages, pass notes, and decision rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations are partially sufficient; final evidence must cite purpose/process, paired test-normal result rows, and decisions.
